fieldValues.title: The branch of a closed, unmerged PR blocks clerk claim, and no routine removes it
fieldValues.summary: srs-rust#1342 was ready and planned, but clerk claim refused it because branch 1342-adr011-schemars-bullet still existed after its PR #1470 closed unmerged on 2026-10-28. A builder commented once; every later run skipped it without repeating, so the only buildable item in the group queue sat idle for two days. Deleted 2026-10-30 at the owner's instruction.
fieldValues.body: Close to 'clerk claim refuses an issue that an open PR only mentions', but the PR is closed. The branch-auditor routine that would catch it is disabled (trigger trig_01FoTFubucDinmgvJBCFD6cb). A remedy: claim ignores branches whose PRs are all closed, or the steward deletes the branches of closed unmerged group PRs.
